name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA validation, evidence, recovery, capture, and draft DSN export.

interface.longDescription: An EasyEDA Pro skill and MCP facade implementing version-pinned readers, scoped durable evidence, canvas capture, draft DSN export, SQLite checkpoints, and conservative recovery for an explicitly admitted connected tuple. The bundled private bridge is currently validation-required, so fresh installs keep exact and private operations fail-closed. The included one-component writer is experimental and runtime-disabled pending connected sacrificial-board validation.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Collect bounded public read evidence for connected candidate review.
Inspect local recovery journals and managed artifacts safely.
